value.rationale: A natural cyclic metric-graph family is globally identifiable from a single unlabelled intrinsic distance histogram, despite general nonuniqueness of such invariants. The result separates cyclic and branching length information through one discontinuity and a collision-robust signed-atom procedure, beyond scalar mean formulas.
